message.title: ASA - Atlantic Sapphire ASA - Mandatory offer document approved
message.body:
Finanstilsynet has approved the offer set out in the offer document dated 30 July 2026 in respect of:

Mandatory offer to acquire the shares in Atlantic Sapphire ASA made by Coral HoldCo AS

Offer price: NOK 0.80 per share in cash

Acceptance period: From and including 31 July 2026 to 16:30 hours (CEST) on 28 August 2026 (subject to extension)

Receiving agent: DNB Carnegie, a part of DNB Bank ASA

Availability of the offer document: https://atlanticsapphire.com/investor-relations/
